title: did:web: resolve the DID document over HTTPS
description:
No module. hire-attestors/src/did_key.rs handles did:key only, and the two share a prefix rather than a trust model.

did:web is iaa2 per SPEC-HIRE, because the DID document is hosted under a domain the user controls, so the claim rests on domain control rather than on self-issuance. That means an HTTPS fetch of the DID document and then a challenge signed by a key the document names.

THE NETWORK IS SETTLED AND THIS IS THE CASE THAT SETTLED IT. See the personad-may-use-the-network memory: hired MAY make outbound connections, and did:web was one of the three reasons given, because did:web is DEFINED as an HTTPS fetch. Do not re-propose a local-only variant.

Treat the fetched document as untrusted input: it is named by something the daemon does not control, which is the standing rule for any name hired resolves.
acceptance_criteria: A did:web identity proven by a challenge signature verified against a key from the fetched document; the document treated as untrusted input; failure to resolve declines rather than degrades to iaa1.
